text.card: A red giant 2,342 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 1.05 solar masses and 9.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,594 K at its surface.
